cohort: 251 women who delivered over a 2-month period
finding: As maternal age increased, there was an increase in gravidity, cesarean deliveries, preterm deliveries, neonatal admissions, and intrauterine deaths.
mod_finding: The proportion of Cesarean deliveries increased as maternal age advanced.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight ranged from 2.6 kg to 2.873 kg across age groups.
